=== Changelog ===
v12.1.5.1
  - fixed cleanup button for warband bank container
  - added toggles for other bag sets to the menu of each container
  - added support for WoW Forever
v12.1.0.1
  - fixed initialization of warband bank, when all slots have been bought
  - fixed positioning of gold requirement when not all slots in the warband bank have been bought
  - fixed junk selling not working anymore
v12.0.0.2
  - fixed an occurance where BB breaks the tooltip comparison
  - now correctly leaving bank(s) when closing the first bank container (on bank vendor) or the first warband bank container (on inhibitor)
v12.0.0.1
  - Reworked some deprecated API accesses.
  - Streamlined TOC usage for classic versions.
v11.2.5.2
  - fixed some issues with time runner recognition, causing issues in warband bank
  - fixed long standing issue resulting in only 1 to 3 tokens being selectable for backpack (now up to 5 tokens can be shown again)
  - reworked search frame:
    - fixed frame not showing up
    - reworked search frame code to also rely on new theme system and look a bit more consistent with the rest of the container look and feel
    - fixed some issues with search in offline bank/warband bank because of WoWs item cache system
  - fixed some weird transparency issues for warband bank and regular bank containers other than the respective first one
v11.2.5.1
  - reworked old background handling to something I call a "theme" and dare it actually might be one in the future
  - new theme system allows for both container background as well as item button configuration
  - non blizz themes now shouldn't show the item button background anymore
  - renamed the original blizzard themes as "classic" variants and added the reworked "dragonflight" ones as new ones
  - added support for time running chars, avoiding warband bank loading until the char is not in time running mode anymore
  - fixed errors when merging two containers in the options panel
  - fixed sizing of the join buttons to not overlap
  - fixed the bank and warband bank full-frame "buy" buttons (for the first bank/warband bank tab)
v11.2.0.1
  - heavily reworked code to be able to disable the old bank code for retail and still use it for classic
  - [retail] support new tab based bank system, this includes
    - tab settings via right click on bag icon in bag overview
    - deposit button in container header (not in offline bank)
    - unlocking of new banks via bag overview and full bag purchase view for the first bank tab
    - bag search
  - [retail] updated warband bank system to be on par with regular bank system
  - [retail] linked regular bank and warband bank in options view (enabling one will enable the other and vice versa)
  - introduced cache migration mechanism to cope with rather substantial structure changes that will make the cache unusable
    - [retail] caches for bank and warband bank will be reset because of the heavy under the hood changes of wow and baud bag (offline banks will not work until you visit the bank)
  - fixes for quite a few annoying bugs:
    - separated warband banks can now be open/closed separately (only whole set worked before)
    - fixed bag highlighting not working for warband bank
    - [retail] bags, bank and warband bag now should work correctly if bank/warband bank have been disabled in the settings
    - view for open/overall bag slots in warband bank now will work even when not visiting the vendor before
    - warband bank now has the same open/close behavior when visiting the vendor as bags and banks when the "auto open" functionality is used
    - the warband bank bag overview in the options will now render correctly even when directly opened after wow launch
    - reduced impact of very annoying bug where the icon borders are replaced (previously that lead to very large borders being shown around the items, this should now stay the correct size even though the border might look slightly different)
    - fixed strange open/close behavior when mixing opening single bags and open all bags shortcut in case fading animations are disabled (behavior is still strange if fading is enabled)
  - hopefully achieved some overall stability and performance improvements, due to heave code rework (will continue)
  - some known issues:
    - filters for bank bags in the bag drop down menu will not work, use the tab settings menu (right click on bag icon) instead
    - bank and warband bank containers will use the name from baud bag options and ignore those in tab settings (but icons from tab settings work)
v11.1.5.1
  - fixes handling of changed itemlinks for battlepets
  - fixes "shown" state of bagframe for warband bank not being followed
  - added support for addon categories
  - added menu entry for showing warband bank
  - removed "enable bank" toggle from menu
v11.0.7.2
  - fixes missing item counts in bags for classic versions
v11.0.7.1
  - fixed some edge case issues on item information retrieval
  - fixed error when trying to change container names
  - added support for deposit/withdrawal on warband bank
  - enabled item search for warband bank
  - updating classic versions with recent API changes
v11.0.2.6
  - adapted how baud bag overrides calls to original bags, to only be called when the addon should be consistently loaded
  - now only updating the reagent bank on update even, when the bank is actually open
  - extended options handling to show the correct icon for warband bags
  - fixed custom version of ItemButton to correctly work with cached battlepet information again
  - fixed a bug where moving stuff around in bags supporting caches (banks) lead to the item appear in the new and the old slot at the same time
  - fixed handling of cached elements to correctly retrieve the item id
  - fixed the purchase button in warbandbanks bag frame to actually work
v11.0.2.5
  - added support for warband bank
    - you can currently only put items into it by manually moving it there, rightclicking from bags does not work and instead try to put into regular bank
    - depositing money is currently not possible
    - bank content does not correctly lock when online with another account that has access to same bank
    - configuring bag joining might not work correctly (everything will be joined by default)
  - fixed bag buttons not updating correctly when not yet bought
  - fixed item levels, now only showing on equipable items again
  - reworked quite some parts of caching and item data handling, so opening the offline banks before visiting a bank should work more reliably now
  - greatly improved IDE support for addon development
v11.0.2.4
  - fixed keyring to actually be able to load in classic flavors
  - fixed offline state recognition for bank when visiting using the "warband distance inhibitor"
  - lots of under the hood improvements to allow supporting warband bank
v11.0.2.3
  - fixed another faulty access to GetSize() in search frame
  - fixed error in ITEM_LOCK_CHANGED event due to not yet supported warband bank
v11.0.2.2
  - fixed default configuration for new chars or bag sets (options window)
  - fixed loading of initial background selection value when switching between bag sets (options window)
  - fixed faulty access to GetSize() in search frame
  - added contribution note in changelog of last version
  - more under the hood reworks, necessary for warband bank
v11.0.2.1
  - fixes for moved C_AddOns APIs
  - fixes for moved C_Bank APIs
  - big under the hood rework of lots of BagSet related mechanics in preparation for warband bank (and more)
  - switched to GitHub Actions for releases
  - added temporary quick-jump to enable/disable bank into container menu until warband bank is supported (contributed by Ketrel, thx!)
v11.0.0.1
  - complete overhaul of the settings code
  - removed all old style dropdowns and replaced with either custom code, popouts (for classic) or the new dropdowns (retail)
  - wrapped more API calls for easier wow flavor hand
